subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining work be a LINE-owned opt-in media batching buffer, a shared media-aware inbound debounce contract, or not planned for now?
rationale: The current source gap is real, but the fix changes channel timing, reply-token behavior, and public config semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: LINE opt-in buffer
options.body: Add a LINE plugin media batching delay keyed by account, conversation, and sender, leaving Telegram and shared text debounce behavior unchanged.

options.title: Shared media debounce contract
options.body: Design a reusable channel SDK/gateway media-aware debounce seam first, then migrate channels that need it behind one contract.

options.title: Do not add batching
options.body: Close or defer the request and document that media-only bursts must be combined by users or handled by channel-specific native grouping.

recommendation.title: LINE opt-in buffer
recommendation.body: Add a LINE plugin media batching delay keyed by account, conversation, and sender, leaving Telegram and shared text debounce behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent LINE media/context history plus repeated channel/config refactors make this the best available routing owner for the product contract decision.
